audit_title: 2025 Geneva–London rare-earth and export-control bargaining: scoped source register
status: Developmental research for parent review; not a final chapter or current legal guidance.

temporal_scope.implementation_check: July 2025 magnet exports reported in August
temporal_scope.later_analysis: IEA October 2025 selected concentration analysis, kept separate from later controls
temporal_scope.historical_comparator: Selected literature and WTO synopsis; no new full reconstruction of the 2010 Japan episode

counting_rule: One record per substantive source, grouping reproductions of the same instrument. Twenty-three substantive records; IDs 20–22 intentionally unused in this evidence set because they were background-only or failed retrievals. Source repetition does not count as independent corroboration.
capture_formats: Raw HTML/PDF downloads are identified separately from derived plain text and rendered browser captures. SHA-256 is over the exact local bytes. Browser captures are source views, not original HTML or underlying datasets.
reading_rule: Complete means all substantive prose and stated supporting apparatus were read, not every navigation element. Selected reading is explicit. Downloaded is not synonymous with read.
key_unavailable_records: Jointly released detailed London framework or an authenticated annex
Chinese internal approval and negotiating instructions
Underlying BIS letters described by Synopsys and Siemens
Matched Chinese application, completeness, license and customs-release records
Underlying GACC July customs extraction used by Reuters

sources.title: 商务部 海关总署公告2025年第18号 公布对部分中重稀土相关物项实施出口管制的决定
sources.author_or_issuing_body: MOFCOM and General Administration of Customs
sources.reading_scope: Full substantive Chinese original, including all seven categories, explanatory notes and final operational paragraphs. Full four-page Hong Kong government reproduction extracted; page 4 visually checked. Full substantive official English reference translation read in browser; raw English download failed, so Chinese original controls.
sources.decisive_locator: Opening State Council approval; items 1C902.a.4, 1C904.a.4 and 1C905.a.4; explanatory note 3; final three substantive paragraphs. PDF pp. 1–4.
sources.supports: Globally framed licensing requirement for specified items, immediate effect, and non-release during customs classification questions.
sources.limits: Not an all-rare-earth ban or a US-only rule. Does not disclose individual decisions, a retaliatory instruction, processing deadlines or a London concession.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Original Chinese notice and Hong Kong reproduction are one instrument, not corroborating witnesses. English is labeled a reference translation.

other_versions.status: Hong Kong Trade and Industry Department reproduction; downloaded and read
Official reference translation; browser text read, original download failed with SSL EOF

sources.title: Joint Statement on U.S.-China Economic and Trade Meeting in Geneva
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Governments of the United States and China; White House publication
sources.reading_scope: Full substantive statement, from opening identification of parties through consultation mechanism.
sources.decisive_locator: Actions by May 14; China subsection (ii); final paragraph naming He Lifeng, Scott Bessent and Jamieson Greer.
sources.supports: Tariff-stage distinction, non-tariff countermeasure undertaking, and continuation mechanism.
sources.limits: Does not name rare earths, repeal Announcement 18, disclose negotiating drafts or set individual license deadlines.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Joint text is primary evidence of the released bargain. Chinese explanatory release EC25-03 is not an independent agreement.

sources.title: 商务部新闻发言人就中美日内瓦经贸会谈联合声明发表谈话
sources.reading_scope: Full substantive release, six paragraphs.
sources.decisive_locator: Paragraphs introducing May 10–11 meetings, reciprocal tariff changes, non-tariff suspension/cancellation and further mechanism.
sources.supports: Chinese public account of the Geneva outcome and dates.
sources.limits: An explanatory statement; does not supply an unpublished annex or a complete Chinese internal mandate.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Overlaps the joint statement; counted as a Chinese explanation, not corroboration of closed-room behavior.

sources.title: 商务部新闻发言人就中重稀土出口管制措施答记者问
sources.reading_scope: Complete question and both answer paragraphs.
sources.decisive_locator: Final answer paragraph: some compliant applications already approved; civilian demands in different countries considered.
sources.supports: Approvals were publicly acknowledged before London; the ministry described a global civilian-use concern.
sources.limits: No numbers, recipient identities, license texts or shipment proofs.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Same official institution as later Q&As; this provides a distinct dated position, not an independent witness.

sources.title: 中美经贸磋商机制首次会议在英国伦敦举行
sources.reading_scope: Full three-paragraph substantive account.
sources.decisive_locator: Opening: June 9–10 and delegation names; agreement in principle on framework. Remaining paragraphs on implementation and continuing talks.
sources.supports: London stage and addition of Lutnick to the listed US delegation.
sources.limits: Does not explain the internal reason for delegation composition or reproduce detailed framework terms.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: One Xinhua official reporting chain. The account of the US position inside it is not a separately acquired US record.

sources.title: 商务部新闻发言人就中美伦敦框架有关情况答记者问
sources.reading_scope: Complete question and answer.
sources.decisive_locator: Answer sentences: agreement in principle; continued contact; 经批准; paired export applications and corresponding US restriction removal.
sources.supports: Publicly described sequence of principle, further communication, approval and confirmed details; explicit reciprocal administrative accommodation.
sources.limits: Approval authority, date, instructions and framework text are not disclosed. Eligible applications are not automatic authorization for all exports.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Official account of its own acts and agreed exchange; not independent proof that either side had already performed.

sources.title: 商务部新闻发言人就美取消相关对华经贸限制措施情况答记者问
sources.reading_scope: Complete question and two answer paragraphs.
sources.decisive_locator: Question names EDA, ethane and aircraft engines; answer says applications being reviewed and US actions notified to China.
sources.supports: Implementation-stage Chinese account and continued licensing language after the framework.
sources.limits: Product names in the question are not item-by-item ministerial certification; not proof of cargo arrival.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Pairs with company originals EC25-08/18 for specific US effects; it cannot independently validate every reported transaction.

sources.title: Synopsys Issues Statement in Connection to the Lifting of Recent U.S. Export Restrictions Related to China
sources.reading_scope: Full substantive statement and forward-looking qualification read; navigation and contact boilerplate not analyzed.
sources.decisive_locator: Paragraph beginning On July 2; final cautionary paragraph.
sources.supports: Company reports BIS rescission of May 29 letter, effective immediately, and work to restore product access.
sources.limits: The BIS letters were not acquired. Working to restore is not the same as completed restoration for all customers.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: First-party recipient account, distinct from Chinese public characterization; repeated PRNewswire versions would be the same source.

sources.title: China’s rare earths are flowing again, but not freely
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Christina Amann and Laurie Chen, Reuters
sources.reading_scope: Entire article body read in the updated syndicated rendering, lines 434–463; saved rendered browser capture, not raw HTML.
sources.decisive_locator: CLEPA Nils Poel; Ford, Volkswagen and Stellantis passages; Dexter CEO Kash Mishra approval account.
sources.supports: Uneven improvement across end users and routes, contemporaneous company relief and continued shortfalls.
sources.limits: Named and anonymous industry observations are not a representative queue audit. Cannot assign every difference to intentional state pressure.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Reuters original reporting syndicated by Investing.com. CLEPA comments overlap its institutional perspective in EC25-19; repeated official framework facts overlap EC25-06/10.

sources.title: US says deal with Beijing will expedite rare earth exports from China
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Nandita Bose and David Lawder, Reuters
sources.source_type: contemporary reporting of public official account
sources.reading_scope: Complete substantive article body, lines 46–65, in updated June 27 rendering. Initial platform timestamp June 26.
sources.decisive_locator: Bessent Fox Business explanation at lines 47–51 and administration official at lines 54–57.
sources.supports: US public explanation linking slow flows, countermeasures and additional understanding on shipment acceleration.
sources.limits: Underlying full interview, additional understanding and signed instrument not recovered. Chinese dual-use explanation partly comes from an unnamed industry source.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: One Reuters article, not independent confirmation of every fact repeated from earlier Reuters reports or MOFCOM.

sources.title: China’s rare earth magnet exports hit six-month high in July
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Amy Lv and Lewis Jackson, Reuters
sources.source_type: contemporary reporting of official trade data
sources.reading_scope: Complete substantive article body, lines 47–59. Platform initial timestamp August 19, updated August 20.
sources.decisive_locator: July global, US and German tonnage; comparison with July 2024.
sources.supports: Physical magnet export recovery in July, including US and German destinations.
sources.limits: Underlying GACC extract not independently downloaded; aggregate magnets do not identify each controlled element, license cohort, end use, inventories or unmet demand.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Reuters interpretation of GACC data; not an additional source for the private London negotiations.

sources.title: China’s sanctions gambit: Formal and informal economic coercion in the second trade war
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Viking Bohman, Audrye Wong and Victor Ferguson; Swedish National China Centre
sources.reading_scope: COMPLETE: all 14 PDF pages, including narrative, author information and references 1–41. Timeline pages 3–4 visually checked. Institutional landing page read for metadata.
sources.decisive_locator: pp. 5–9 on formal/informal tools, implementation discretion and Europe; note 17 defines individual restrictions as counting unit; notes 25–41 reveal news/primary chains.
sources.supports: Interpretation of increasingly formal sanctions combined with discretion; longer comparative framing and alternative explanations for European delays.
sources.limits: Not a peer-reviewed journal article or interview transcript. London claims follow contemporary reporting. Timeline wrongly labels April rare-earth round 14 March and Geneva deal 6 May (pp. 2–4); use primary dates. Speculation about officials’ relief or deliberate European warning is not private evidence.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Institutional PDF acquired from AEI mirror, with exact matching title/authors and original institution landing page. Dataset not independently reconstructed. Repeated Reuters/WSJ facts are not corroboration.

sources.title: How Export Restrictions Threaten Economic Security
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Chad P. Bown; Peterson Institute for International Economics, Working Paper 25-11
sources.reading_scope: SELECTED: title/abstract and introduction on pp. 1–2; pp. 10–14, including complete section 3.2 and associated footnotes. Remainder not claimed read.
sources.decisive_locator: Section 3.2, pp. 10–14; notes 34–39 on earlier restrictions, litigation and Japanese diversification.
sources.supports: Historical counterweight to novelty claims; distinguishes material-supply exposure from trade-value totals and highlights diversification problems.
sources.limits: Predates London; cannot corroborate its negotiations. Brief summary links 2010 episode and WTO litigation; EC25-26 is used to keep the adjudicated measures distinct. Earlier source references are leads, not books or articles acquired in this audit.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Secondary synthesis with explicit sources. Working paper says a revised journal version was planned; no claim here to have read that later version.

sources.title: With new export controls on critical minerals, supply concentration risks become reality
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Tae-Yoon Kim, Shobhan Dhir, Amrita Dasgupta and Alessio Scanziani; International Energy Agency
sources.event_or_data_period: 2024 production data and discussion of 2025 developments
sources.reading_scope: SELECTED: opening and first rare-earth concentration section, its 2024 chart note, and April disruption paragraph. Later October-control/battery sections were retrieved but are outside this reconstruction and are not treated as fully reviewed.
sources.decisive_locator: Rare-earth supply-chain section; Regional composition chart note specifying four magnet rare earths and NdFeB magnet scope.
sources.supports: 2024 mining/refining concentration and longer-run increase in magnet-manufacturing concentration; the industrial basis of dependence.
sources.limits: Later publication. Its legal summary is broader than the April instrument; EC25-01 controls exact coverage. Market share alone does not prove a negotiating instruction or causal effect.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Institutional analysis with stated denominators; underlying complete data series not reproduced or independently audited.

sources.title: 商务部新闻发言人就美方有关言论答记者问
sources.reading_scope: Complete question and answer.
sources.decisive_locator: Answer names AI-chip guidance, EDA sales restrictions and visas; denies violation and demands US correction.
sources.supports: Chinese public compliance claim and stated grounds for blaming the US after Geneva.
sources.limits: Party position rather than adjudicated breach; no complete internal account of the measures’ origins.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Distinct dated official position; shares the Chinese governmental source family.

sources.title: 习近平同美国总统特朗普通电话
sources.reading_scope: Full substantive readout, browser lines 98–105 and corresponding downloaded text.
sources.decisive_locator: Xi’s request to reverse negative measures; final sentence agreeing teams should continue and meet promptly.
sources.supports: Public leader-level intervention and announced next negotiation step.
sources.limits: Not a transcript; Trump’s position is presented in the Chinese readout. No rare-earth schedule or internal delegation instructions.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Chinese readout is one-sided evidence of the public account; not paired verbatim private call records.

sources.title: US-China trade truce leaves military-use rare earth issue unresolved, sources say
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Laurie Chen and Fanny Potkin, Reuters
sources.reading_scope: Entire substantive article body, lines 47–77, in updated June 15 syndicated rendering.
sources.decisive_locator: Two briefed sources and non-response disclosure, lines 48–52; reported linkage, Bessent position, non-military fast track and six-month terms, lines 55–66.
sources.supports: Attributed account of attempted linkage and limits of the reported London accommodation.
sources.limits: Two anonymous briefed sources, with some details attributed to only one. No disclosed license text or private mandate. Attempted advanced-chip linkage is not a completed bargain; public US rejection appears in the same article.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Reuters original reporting; syndicated/repeated versions are one chain. Different Reuters articles may share sources, so source independence is not assumed.

sources.title: A statement from Tony Hemmelgarn
sources.reading_scope: Complete three-paragraph English body on Siemens’ Italian-locale site, dated 3 luglio 2025.
sources.decisive_locator: First paragraph identifies May 23 letter; second reports restoration for ECCNs 3D991 and 3E991 and resumed sales/support.
sources.supports: Specific corporate operational implementation beyond receipt of regulatory relief.
sources.limits: First-party report; no underlying BIS letter or customer-level audit. Still expressly subject to applicable export-control rules.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Independent corporate recipient from Synopsys; separate experience under related US action, not independent evidence of Chinese private motives.

sources.title: Urgent action needed as China’s export restrictions on rare earths disrupt European automotive supply chains
sources.author_or_issuing_body: CLEPA, European Association of Automotive Suppliers
sources.reading_scope: Complete two-page PDF including body, organizational description and contact page.
sources.decisive_locator: Page 1: production shutdowns, hundreds of applications, roughly one-quarter approval, procedural/IP concerns.
sources.supports: Contemporary European industry account before London; requests transparent procedures and warns of no short-term substitute.
sources.limits: Interested advocacy body; reported approval share lacks an application-level dataset or sampling appendix. Not government verification of motive.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Original association release; later CLEPA remarks in Reuters partly repeat the same institutional vantage point.

sources.title: 商务部召开例行新闻发布会（2025年5月29日）
sources.reading_scope: SELECTED: complete Phoenix TV and CNBC questions and answers concerning post-Geneva semiconductor restrictions and April rare-earth controls; other briefing topics not fully reviewed.
sources.decisive_locator: Phoenix TV question on further consultations; CNBC question asking under what conditions April 4 controls would be canceled or suspended.
sources.supports: Public description of continuing multilevel contacts, repeated representations about US controls, and no stated repeal condition in response.
sources.limits: An unanswered repeal-condition question is not proof that repeal was privately impossible or never discussed.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Official record; reporter premises are not ministerial confirmations.

sources.title: 商务部召开例行新闻发布会（2025年7月10日）
sources.reading_scope: SELECTED: passages on continued US contacts and complete Global Times question/answer on EU complaints, with the export-control paragraph read closely; other topics not fully reviewed.
sources.decisive_locator: Global Times response, paragraph beginning 关于出口管制.
sources.supports: Ministry says it established a green channel to accelerate approval for European enterprises.
sources.limits: Official claim does not enumerate licenses or show the speed improvement for each applicant; not evidence that London caused European relief.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Independent dated policy account within same ministry series; pairs with affected-industry observations without converting them into one dataset.

sources.title: Analysis—The world’s auto supply chain is in the hands of a few Chinese bureaucrats
sources.author_or_issuing_body: Laurie Chen and Lewis Jackson, Reuters
sources.reading_scope: Entire article body, lines 52–108, including alternative explanations and source-status qualifications.
sources.decisive_locator: Lines 61–74 on reported staffing and verification limits; 79–88 on procedure; 92–105 on competing explanations and single-source Geneva account.
sources.supports: Application-processing burden, evidence consistent with capacity constraints, and one source’s report that China accepted rare earths as countermeasures at Geneva.
sources.limits: The private Geneva claim rests on one person briefed on talks. Staffing is partly anonymous, with current authority unverified. Claims of strategic excuses are attributed opinions, not demonstrated instructions.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Reuters reports underlying interviews and public documents; the later NKK brief cites this article. Do not count that repetition as corroboration.

sources.title: DS431: China—Measures Related to the Exportation of Rare Earths, Tungsten and Molybdenum
sources.reading_scope: SELECTED: consultation description, overview of challenged duties/quotas/trading restrictions, and adoption/implementation chronology; browser lines 39–45, 60–82 and 106–113. Full judgments not read in this audit.
sources.decisive_locator: Measures overview; May 20, 2015 statement of implementation.
sources.supports: Establishes earlier formal export restrictions and distinct WTO dispute scope.
sources.limits: Not a finding on all allegations about Japan-specific shipments in 2010; China’s reported implementation is identified as its statement. Does not determine WTO status of the 2025 instrument.
sources.independence_and_source_chain: Official WTO synopsis, not a substitute for full adjudication records. Used only to prevent conflating the earlier episodes.

quality_checks: Chinese authentic notice obtained in addition to English reference translation.
Geneva dates and London stages kept separate.
NKK timeline labels checked visually against primary dates.
Siemens completed restoration distinguished from Synopsys work in progress.
Reuters single-/two-source process claims explicitly attributed.
No repeal inferred from licensing relief.
No general advanced-chip concession inferred from EDA relief.
No S-P25 asymmetry verdict inferred from continuation alone.
